body.p: Tagging is used to capture a specific point in history, for example to mark a release. A tag is like a branch that doesn't change. You can create tags from the History view contextual menu. In the Ellipsis (three vertical dots) menu on the right side of the Git Staging view's toolbar, there is a Show tags action that lists all the tags. Both local and already pushed tags can be deleted from this dialog box. For tags present only in the local branch, you can choose to push them to the remote repository. The Show tags action is also available in the Git menu from the main menu bar.
